result.rationale: addGuests.schema.ts defines guests as z.array(z.string().email()) with no uniqueness refine, unlike the client schema in AddGuestsDialog. In the handler, uniqueGuests only filters against existing booking attendees and blacklist (`!booking.attendees.some(...)`), not within the input array, so duplicate guest emails in one request pass through and createMany would insert duplicate attendee rows. Verifiable directly from the diff.

judged_text: ZAddGuestsInputSchema only validates email format and does not enforce the uniqueness rule the client schema enforces, so the API contract accepts duplicate guests. Any non-UI caller (or the UI if the client check drifts) can send ['a@x.com','a@x.com']; the handler filters only against existing attendees, not within the array, so createMany inserts duplicate attendee rows and duplicate emails are sent.
